relationships.evidence_quote: Our results showed that expression of TNF-α, IL-1β and IL-6 was significantly increased in DRG neurons after SNI and inhibited by Rh2 treatment.

relationships.subject: DRG TLR8
relationships.evidence_quote: intrathecal injection of TLR8 agonist VTX-2337 reversed the analgesic effect of Rh2 but not in TLR8 knockout mice

key_findings: Intrathecal ginsenoside Rh2 attenuated SNI-induced mechanical allodynia and thermal hyperalgesia and suppressed spinal microglial and astrocytic activation.
Rh2 reduced DRG miRNA-21, pERK and proinflammatory cytokines; the TLR8 agonist VTX-2337 reversed Rh2 analgesia, implicating the miRNA-21-TLR8-MAPK axis.
